goal: P2: Build cache carry: clone the Gate's build output into Worker sandboxes as a distinct, explicitly unsafe BuildCache artifact under trusted-local policy.

deliverables: review.kernel/BuildCache@1 with producer and head provenance, regular-file-only layout, no-follow traversal, entry, depth and byte limits, fixed modes and stripped xattrs; never typed or named as a Cache Snapshot
cargo_target closed cache kind that points CARGO_TARGET_DIR at the clone
Gate-to-Worker typed handoff of the cache within one Round; refused under the safe policy
Cache bytes removed before seal so they never enter a candidate tree or Proposal
acceptance: A safe pipeline refuses the handoff before any Worker dispatch
A symlink, FIFO or special file in the Gate's target directory refuses capture with a recorded reason
A TDD reviewer fixture reuses the Gate build and the sealed diff is unchanged
